maddeler.e:
اصطخدن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَدْنَ (iṣṭaḵadna) /isˤ.tˤa.xad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# اُصْطُخِدْنَ (uṣṭuḵidna) /usˤ.tˤu.xid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# اِصْطَخِدْنَ (iṣṭaḵidna) /isˤ.tˤa.xid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
